title: Training army intelligence officers in remote viewing

tellings.quote: well the reason i stopped was i was already working uh frankly 24 hours a day on on training the army intelligence officers

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff says he once worked "24 hours a day" training US Army intelligence officers in remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe distant places or things using only the mind. Puthoff tells it as the man who did the training, mentioning it to explain why he stopped other work, and if true it means the Army took this ability seriously enough to train its own officers in it.
